name: codex-batch-coder
description: Queue well-scoped coding tasks for OpenAI Batch patch generation and apply candidates in isolated worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Run queued coding patch candidates through OpenAI Batch.
interface.longDescription: Codex Batch Coder packages localized coding tasks, submits them to the OpenAI Batch API, imports structured patch candidates, and validates them in isolated git worktrees.
